svg.title: Lineage of the configurations
svg.desc: The one-change chain of Phase 1: Ordinary MoE, Finer experts, Deeper, narrower, Expert layout, Residual scale, The loop. Published designs drawn as children of the ordinary MoE or of the loop, as scripts/lineage.py declares: Prelude, loop, coda; Flattened core; Tied expert banks; Recurrent core; Decaying re-entry; Whole stack, averaged state; Whole stack, learned exit; Whole stack, low-rank delta; Middle loop; Middle loop; Residual per visit.
